verdict.rationale: Better Stack automatically builds an incident timeline that includes alerts, on-call actions (ack/escalate), and Slack chat, and uses it to generate an automated post-mortem (docs-3, docs-9, docs-38, docs-23). However, there is no evidence describing the ability to manually edit or annotate the timeline after the fact. missing for 10: explicit editing/annotation UI or API for the incident timeline, evidence of manual timeline entry additions, independent confirmation of timeline accuracy/completeness.
